description: This file is a PHP class named SubscriptionPlan within the Opencart admin controller namespace, managing subscription plans in the catalog. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, copying, enabling, disabling, and deleting subscription plans, leveraging the OpenCart framework components such as models, views, URLs, and language support.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription plans in the Opencart admin interface, providing CRUD operations and status management for subscription plans.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the subscription plan list page with header, footer, breadcrumb, and data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to generate the subscription plan list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves subscription plans data with filtering, sorting, and pagination, returning the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a subscription plan.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing subscription plan, with validation and permission checks, returning JSON response.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies selected subscription plans, returning JSON result.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected subscription plans, returning JSON result.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected subscription plans, returning JSON result.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscription plans after checks, returning JSON result.
